ECM-2124                                                                                                            about:srcdoc  
  
  
  Exam Date & Time: 02-Dec-2024 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MIT BLR - BTech III Semester - End Semester Examination - Nov / Dec -2024  
  Object Oriented Programming [ECM-2124]  
  Marks: 50                                                                             Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           Differentiate between break and continue statement.  
  (2)  
  A)  
  B)      Compare Method Overriding and Method Overloading.                                       (3)  
  C)      Create a list of 5 book objects. Each book object is associated with a Title, Author, Price  
  and ISBN. Write a complete Java program to arrange the 5 books in alphabetical order (5)  
  of their title and display them (display all fields of each book).  
  
  2)           Two String objects with identical values are not equal when == operator is used.  
  Explain.  
  (2)  
  A)  
  B)      Discuss about the static, final keywords with an example.                               (3)  
  C)      Create an interface called "TelecomServices" with methods "voicecharges" and  
  "datacharges". Create classes "Prepaid" and "Postpaid" that use the interface  
  "TelecomServices". Calculate the voice charges and data charges for both Prepaid and    (5)  
  Postpaid connections using appropriate methods. The methods should use the variables  
  "callrate" and "duration" in order to find out the service charges.  
  
  3)           Explain the difference between checked and un-checked exception.  
  (2)  
  A)  
  B)      Explain the role of interfaces while implementing multiple inheritance                  (3)  
  C)      Create a class Vehicle, derive classes Ship & Plane from class Vehicle. In main method  
  create objects of Vehicle, Ship & Plane and when the display method is called it should  
  display "moves on land" for Vehicle object. "moves in air" for plane object & "moves on  
  water" for ship object. The following conditions should be strictly considered while    (5)  
  defining the classes:  
  i. The display method is present only in the Vehicle class  
  ii. No usage of constructors in any of the class

  4)              Explain with example: a) sleep( )   b) wait( )  
  (2)  
  A)  
  B)         List Java's Built-in Exception? Write the importance of finally block.                      (3)  
  C)         Describe the need of thread synchronization. How is it achieved in Java programming?  
  Explain with a suitable program.                                                            (5)  
  
  5)              Explain the use of wildcards in Java generics (?) with example.  
  (2)  
  A)  
  B)         Write a simple example of a generic method that takes a list of any type and returns the  
  first element.                                                                              (3)  
  
  C)         Define a generic interface in Java called Convertible that has a method convert which  
  takes an argument of one type and returns another type. Implement a class  
  StringToIntegerConverter that implements this interface to convert a String to an  
  Integer.  
  (5)  
  1. Define the Convertible interface with generic types.  
  2. Implement the StringToIntegerConverter class, showing how it performs the  
  String to Integer conversion.  
  
  
  -----End-----
